paper.title: Ultrastructural Details of Mammalian Chromosome Architecture
paper.baseline: Micro-C in human ESCs and fibroblasts recovers compartments and topological domains while resolving fine boundaries, loops, dots and extrusion stripes with greater dynamic range than Hi-C.

minimumEvidence: contact-map QC includes resolution, coverage, sparsity and balancing status
distance-decay behavior is compared between cell states
compartment or insulation evidence is evaluated on both chromosomes
candidate state differences are checked across scale or window choices
strong structural claims include an alternative technical explanation and validation plan

requiredResults: TeX source, BibTeX and paper-style PDF
